description: Source code for parsing and converting OpenIOC data into MISPEvent objects, including mappings and attribute extraction functions.

methods.name: load_openioc_file
methods.description: Loads an OpenIOC file from a given path and processes it into a MISPEvent.

methods.name: load_openioc
methods.description: Parses an openioc string or file object into a MISPEvent, extracting fields and attributes.

methods.name: get_mapping
methods.description: Retrieves mapping information for a given OpenIOC type string.

methods.name: set_values
methods.description: Constructs attribute values and types from indicator items, including composite handling.

methods.name: set_all_attributes
methods.description: Processes indicator items and composites in the OpenIOC report to add attributes to the MISPEvent.
